verdict.rationale: Capacities is object-type-first: users define custom object types with core properties, prefill them via templates, and have AI auto-fill them. Date properties surface on daily notes, and properties export as front matter. Community users confirm that tags work and that media can be tagged and organized. missing for 10: first-party documentation of property data types (typed fields) and of a tag system, plus detailed docs on querying and filtering by properties or tags beyond a pricing-page mention of 'Smart queries'.
